pr_title: [Performance][SFA] Reduce prefill KV all-gather communication for PCP/DCP
source_quote: The two parts of the if statement are combined together.

rule.description: 当多个 if 条件语句处理逻辑存在重叠或可以合并时，应将条件合并为一个统一的判断，减少代码冗余，提高可读性和可维护性。

antipattern.code:
# if 语句的两个分支分开处理，存在冗余逻辑

def sfa_prefill_cp(
    query, key, value,
    block_table,
    pcp_size, dcp_size,
    ...
):
    """SFA prefill with context parallel KV all-gather optimization."""
    # 第一部分：判断是否需要 compact block gathering
    if pcp_size > 1 or dcp_size > 1:
        # 构建 compact block view
        compact_blocks = build_compact_block_view(block_table)
        # 执行 targeted gather
        kv_gathered = compact_kv_gather(key, value, compact_blocks)

    # 第二部分：判断是否混合 prefill/decode batch
    if has_mixed_batch:
        # 复用 full KV view 避免冗余通信
        kv_full = reuse_full_kv_view(kv_gathered, block_table)
        # 使用 full KV 进行 attention 计算
        attn_output = compute_attention(query, kv_full)
    else:
        attn_output = compute_attention(query, kv_gathered)

    return attn_output
antipattern.context: The two parts of the if statement are combined together.

pattern.code:
# commit 4e04588 "Update sfa_cp_pd" (+142/-158)
# 合并 if 语句的两个部分，减少冗余代码
# 后续 commit 6bf6701 和 49d334e 进一步更新了 sfa_cp.py

def sfa_prefill_cp(
    query, key, value,
    block_table,
    pcp_size, dcp_size,
    ...
):
    """SFA prefill with context parallel KV all-gather optimization."""
    # 合并两个条件判断为一个统一的处理流程
    if (pcp_size > 1 or dcp_size > 1):
        # 构建 compact block view 并执行 targeted gather
        compact_blocks = build_compact_block_view(block_table)
        kv_gathered = compact_kv_gather(key, value, compact_blocks)

        # 混合 batch 时复用 full KV view，否则直接使用 gathered KV
        if has_mixed_batch:
            kv_input = reuse_full_kv_view(kv_gathered, block_table)
        else:
            kv_input = kv_gathered
    else:
        kv_input = full_kv_gather(key, value, block_table)

    attn_output = compute_attention(query, kv_input)
    return attn_output
pattern.context: The two parts of the if statement are combined together.
